description:
Pre-existing clippy warning in crate-jmap-mail-types/src/email.rs:597:9 fails 'cargo clippy --workspace --tests -- -D warnings':

```
error: doc list item without indentation
  --> crate-jmap-mail-types/src/email.rs:597:9
```

Discovered while running pre-commit gate for JMAP-tjvm.37 (queryChanges wire-shape regression tests sweep). The file was NOT touched by that work — this is pre-existing.

Fix: re-indent the affected list item under its parent doc comment per https://rust-lang.github.io/rust-clippy/master/index.html#doc_list_item_without_indentation. The fix is mechanical and out of scope for any feature/test bead.

Companion beads tracking other pre-existing clippy issues from the same workspace cargo clippy run: JMAP-79qy / JMAP-taw2 (needless_borrows in metadata_types test), JMAP-l35v (type_complexity in jscontact-types lib test). Two more untracked errors filed alongside this one.
title: (BUG) clippy doc_list_item_without_indentation in jmap-mail-types email.rs
